title: BiyaHey! free-ride route overrides
description: Shape of data/fares/free-ride-routes.yaml (spec 8.3, ruling R25). The list ships empty because no free-ride service contract has been corroborated; every future row must cite where the zero fare was verified. Validated by `npm run validate:data`.

routes.description: Route ids whose fare is overridden to a free ride. Empty by design in the unverified seed.

route_id.description: GTFS route id exactly as published in data/build/gtfs/routes.txt, lowercased and without MOTIS's `gtfs_` namespace prefix (e.g. jeep-t101, bus-23).

source_url.description: The primary source (LTFRB/DOTr notice or operator announcement) that states the zero fare. Required so an unverified row cannot be added.

verified_on.description: Date the source was last checked, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

notes.description: Free-form operator/scope context, verbatim from the source.
